configuration.prompt_tokens_semantics: First floor(3*N/4) tokens of each original full article.
configuration.output_tokens_semantics: Declared1024 maximum; natural EOS or first generated blank line may stop earlier.
configuration.resource_state: Requested capacity; actual allocation requires runtime verification.
configuration.input_preparation: See selected workload.json; source population and split documented in protocol.json.
configuration.input_independence: Exploratory seen documents with fixed75% prefixes; new task, not independent confirmation.
configuration.admission_rule: Complete cap256/native guard256; KV floor0; no extra delay.

final_visible_text.semantics: Final text is recorded only on completed requests. Missing is not empty. First visible text means nonempty text, including whitespace.

timing_semantics: All latencies start at external arrival. Distributions retain all planned requests in their CDF denominator; quantiles condition on observed values. Token IDs include generated stop tokens; visible text excludes the stop string and has a one-character streaming buffer. Token TTFT is not first visible text. Missing text time remains missing. Host engine.step return includes detokenization and stop handling costs.

observed_state.semantics: Extrema of recorded snapshots and actual gate evaluations only; not continuous GPU peaks. Missing fields remain missing; gate sampling is decision-dependent.

admission_observations.semantics: Repeated evaluations are not distinct requests. FIFO rows have no checked fit. Native waiting allocation failures include recovery attempts; new-gate fit refusals do not. A gate denial is deferral, not dropped or failed service.
